analysis.headline: Shares Your Info with Affiliates
analysis.quote: Since each of our Affiliates and Brands (as detailed in our HR Tech Privacy Center ) shares this core mission, we developed a Privacy Center as a way of educating our users about our affiliates, and how we share data with them to provide the strongest product and service offerings to our users.

analysis.headline: Your Profile Shared by Default
analysis.quote: By creating a profile set to “Employers can find you” through the Site including when you upload a file resume on the Site, you are requesting and authorizing Indeed to make available your profile data to third parties, in accordance with our Terms.

analysis.headline: Employers Share Your Data
analysis.quote: Please note employers and employer representatives who access your profile data while it is set to “Employers can find you”, or to whom you apply with your profile set to Employers can’t find you”, may choose to share your profile with additional parties. Indeed is not responsible for such sharing.

analysis.headline: AI Evaluation for Your Application
analysis.quote: Employers may use Indeed Recruiting Services to generate an AI-powered summary evaluation and a generalized match rating of applications received.

analysis.headline: Automated Processing Affects You
analysis.quote: We perform automated processing of Personal Data to evaluate specific aspects relating to a user and to analyze and predict a user’s preferences and interests.

analysis.headline: Trains AI on Your Personal Data
analysis.quote: In support of these goals, we use personal data to develop, train, build and use statistical models, including artificial intelligence (“AI”), which allows Job Seekers and Employers to quickly and easily find one another and determine if they are a good match.

analysis.headline: Monitors All Your Site Activity
analysis.quote: We collect, record, process, analyze, and store any and all activities you take on the Site and on the affiliated sites , and any and all interactions and communications you have with, on, or through the Site and affiliated sites.

analysis.headline: Buys Your Profile from Third Parties
analysis.quote: We purchase resumes and other profile information from third parties where permitted by applicable law and in line with this Privacy Policy.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Demographic Data
analysis.quote: Under limited circumstances, we collect and process special category data. We only collect and process this data in certain markets where permissible by law.
